neighbours.label: Low-confidence guess: the orientation of an object being moved or aimed, on the pointer word or pronoun before its direction ('arrow facing ...', 'move it up and down').
fire: The mouse pointer changes to a two-headed arrow facing along the edge of the window.
You can slide the shelf forwards or backwards, and you can also raise it up and down.
You can steer the turret left or right, and you can also tip it up and down.
On the chart there is a thick red arrow pointing up at the peak.
Pan the lens from side to side, then tilt it up and down slowly.
The signpost has a wooden hand pointing left along the narrow track.
Each triangle on the map is a marker facing in the direction of the wind.
Grab the slider with your mouse and drag it up and down the bar.
quiet: The mouse pointer is a cheap model that I bought along with the keyboard.
You can buy the shelf online or in the shop, and you can also rent it.
You can paint the turret green or grey, and you can also leave it bare.
On the chart there is a thick red line for the budget of each year.
Clean the lens with a soft cloth, then store it in the case carefully.
The signpost has a wooden frame painted white by the local council.
Each triangle on the map is a marker for a campsite with fresh water.
Grab the file with your mouse and save it in the shared folder.
